title: A familiar editor workspace with visible progress
summary: The first matching editor shell puts tools across the top and properties on the right, with temporary Ready and provisional target labels beside mapped features.

Added: File, Edit, Image, Share, View, and Help menus, a tool strip with scrollable More menu, and all 20 surveyed tool names plus ClipCraft's Redact tool.
Compact green Ready labels for verified behavior and red provisional target-version labels for unfinished scopes. Hide them through View or the Badges checkbox.
Original vector tool icons and explicit planned states for unfinished tools, Quick Styles, Library, and Effects. Planned tools cannot draw on the canvas.
Improved: Centered fit canvas, a fixed right properties pane, compact-window overflow, and bottom Effects/Properties controls.
Existing arrow creation, selection/movement, Undo/Redo, text editing, project saving, and PNG export remain connected to the shared document engine.
Exports with development badges shown or hidden match exactly; overlay settings do not change project contents or dirty state.

limitations: This is the first editor shell, not completed 1:1 interface parity. Detailed menus, tool properties, dialogs, capture controls, library, and video views remain in progress.
The Windows title bar is retained. Badges add vertical space; further DPI and accessibility checks remain pending.
Quick Styles, effects, clipboard, callouts, sharing, and history are planned. Red targets are provisional, not delivery commitments. A green label covers only the scope in its tooltip.
Text still uses a dialog with two bundled fonts and basic left-to-right layout. Advanced formatting and inline entry are not included.
Screen capture and global hotkeys are not included. Windows x64 portable alpha; not code-signed.
Editable projects retain original image pixels. Share flattened PNGs when redacting content.
